# dsh-spec-kit-tonulls-en

English DSH plugin variant for Spec Kit. Skill descriptions and command responses use English.

Install into the `web` profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add 'git+https://github.com/tonulls/dsh-plugins.git#tonulls&path:/dsh-[name]-tonulls/dsh-spec-kit-tonulls/packages/dsh-spec-kit-tonulls-en'
```

The bundled skill content is in English.

Automatic selection is off by default. Use `/dsh-spec-kit-tonulls on` to enable it for the current Agent and `/dsh-spec-kit-tonulls off` to turn it off. Direct invocation is available with `/spec-kit`.
